rule: Spring tides occur near new moon and full moon
texts: Spring tides occur at new moon or at full moon.
The Keepers time the salt-bloom harvest to the new-moon spring tide.

fields.sentence: Spring tides occur at new moon or at full moon.

q2_gaps: a disjunction in a RULE'S CONSEQUENT — the instruction set scopes (Or ...) narrowly inside an asserted fact and splits a disjunctive rule PREMISE into one rule per disjunct, but says nothing about an (Or ...) standing as a conclusion

a light verb over an event-noun ("spring tides OCCUR at ...") in a bare-plural GENERIC — the light-verb rule is stated for a specific occurrence, and the instruction set does not say how it composes with the verbal-generic rule form whose consequent normally mints a Skolem event
review.notes: The definitional 1.0/0.99 rather than the empirical generic 0.9/0.9 is a judgment the dial permits if a spring tide is definitionally the syzygy tide, and inclusive Or is the correct default with no exclusivity cue. new_moon/full_moon are left undecomposed, which the Time section's bare-symbol treatment of named times supports over the compound-decomposition rule.

fields.sentence: The Keepers time the salt-bloom harvest to the new-moon spring tide.

q1_issues.issue: the temporal-alignment 'to'-PP ('time the harvest to the new-moon spring tide') is given the spatial Goal role, which the instruction set reserves for whither-PPs and repeatedly warns off non-path 'to' (never a spatial Goal for a result 'into', never for a MeasureTo endpoint); a PP answering none of where/when/how/whence/whither routes to the preposition-named oblique instead.

new_moon_spring_tide is emitted as a bare untyped role filler -- neither the Member typing every definite referent gets nor the head genus (Inheritance new_moon_spring_tide tide) that Compound concepts says is always emitted, so a three-word compound NP enters the KB with no link to anything.
the per-member distribution rule repeats both problems verbatim (same Goal head, same untyped tide constant).

q2_gaps: a capitalized plural kind-word label with no name-hood signal ('the Keepers'): Names and casing says the capitalized-common-noun default is 'singular-collective only' and that a capitalized plural kind-word label referring as a name is a Name-only individual with no GroupOf, yet gives no test for when such a plural is 'referring as a name' rather than an ordinary definite plural -- the two halves of the rule point to different parses here

a recurring natural-cycle event NP used as a temporal anchor ('the new-moon spring tide'): no route is given -- deictic-style bare time constant, event-noun sk_ witness, or ordinary definite with typing and compound decomposition
review.notes: Patient for 'the salt-bloom harvest' is right per the explicit occurrence-object rule (a verb that changes when an occurrence happens alters it), as are the fused salt_bloom_harvest with genus harvest and noun modifier unexposed, the absent tense atom on a habitual present, and the group-event-plus-per-member-rule pairing for a definite plural with a non-collective predicate.

issues.reason: The named obliques apply only when the PP answers where/when/how/whence/whither and the set says to decide by the question the PP answers, never by which listed role is closest; 'time the harvest TO the tide' names an alignment target, not a whither, so Goal asserts a spatial destination the text does not state and the licensed form is the preposition-named oblique (To sk_time_1 …).

A definite description is a typed witness and an event-denoting noun ('the storm') stays an ordinary sk_ entity rather than a deictic constant, while Compound concepts says the head genus of a minted compound symbol is always emitted — so the untyped, genus-less new_moon_spring_tide violates both and enters the KB linked to nothing.
The per-member rule repeats the Goal head and the untyped constant verbatim, so the same two violations recur inside its consequent.

gaps_confirmed: narrowed: the plural-label rule's 'referring as a name' qualifier has no stated test — though its structure (the common-noun default is singular-collective only) still routes a capitalized plural kind-word label to the Name-only individual

a recurring natural-cycle event NP as a habitual time slot ('the new-moon spring tide'): the time vocabulary has no term for it and the deictic-constant route is speech-anchored only, so the sole licensed carrier is an ordinary typed witness in the surface To oblique, which records the preposition but not the temporal alignment
new_gaps: 'time X to Y' (aligning an occurrence with a recurring event) has no dedicated head — the opaque To oblique is surface-faithful, but a 'when is the harvest?' question cannot bind it as a Time
adjudication.defect_summary: Issue 0: (To sk_time_1 sk_tide_1) in place of Goal; issue 1: (Member sk_tide_1 new_moon_spring_tide) plus (Inheritance new_moon_spring_tide tide) with the noun modifiers new_moon and spring unexposed, the witness filling the oblique; issue 2: the same two corrections inside the rule consequent — if any rule survives at all.
adjudication.notes: Unfiled by the reviewer: 'the Keepers' is a capitalized plural kind-word label, which Names and casing makes a Name-only individual with no GroupOf and no per-member kind, so keepers_group and the distribution rule are themselves unlicensed. Patient for the timed harvest (an occurrence object) and the salt_bloom_harvest fusion with genus harvest are correct.
